findings.summary: The unanchored operational-help match diverts complete lecture questions to help, making the intended learning task harder to understand and complete.
findings.fix: Restrict operational-help detection to complete operational utterances, preserving contextual lesson questions such as ‘영상이 멈췄을 때 관성은 어떻게 작용해?’ as question; retain local help for ‘영상이 멈췄어’ and ‘왜 재생이 안돼?’. Add both sides as routing regressions.
findings.evidence: The help regex matches ‘영상이멈췄’ anywhere before interrogative detection; ‘영상이 멈췄을 때 관성은 어떻게 작용해?’ therefore returns help and app.js opens showHelp().

findings.summary: An ordinary explanation request containing ‘멈추’ is rejected as an unclear control when its subject lacks a word from the topic allowlist.
findings.fix: Preserve clear explanation requests outside the whole-command control grammar without requiring the current topic noun allowlist; add ‘핵융합이 멈추는 과정을 설명해줘’ as a question regression while keeping genuinely ambiguous control fragments local.
findings.evidence: ‘핵융합이 멈추는 과정을 설명해줘’ matches no interrogative, explanation noun or topic allowlist; legacy returns pause because of ‘멈추’, then line 74 returns clarify. app.js tells the student to enter a shorter playback command.

findings.summary: The ambiguous playback fragment ‘재생 좀’ is treated as a lecture question instead of receiving local clarification, giving the student an unrelated response path.
findings.fix: Recognize ambiguous utterances consisting of an operational target and request filler before returning legacy chat; route ‘재생 좀’ to clarify locally and add a regression asserting that no agent-turn request occurs.
findings.evidence: ‘재생 좀’ misses local, whole-command, help and question rules; the shared router returns chat. app.js labels it 강의 질문 and commandImpl falls through to ask(text), which posts the fragment to agent-turn.

passed: Whole-utterance controls take priority over question detection, including the reviewed polite and urgent stop/play forms.
command() resolves intent once and passes it to commandImpl(); question intent returns ask(text, forceSpeak) before legacy substring branches and preserves original text.
Monitored command completion requires result === true; held and stale question responses return false, avoiding success feedback on those paths.

The installed-extension regression source covers preserved question text, playback effects, typed and ASR entry, local ambiguity/help, held output, stale response cancellation and raw-media upload absence.
